# Disentomb: "Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand."
# Shape: B5b-return-cards-hand ("Return target permanent card ..." / "up to two target creature
# cards ...") with count 1 and filter TYPE_EQ Creature (Shipwreck Dowser's MOVE_ZONE shape).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

mapping.notes: B5b-return-cards-hand shape with count 1, TYPE_EQ Creature. Probe target slot offers only you_fallen.
